title: The pinned run-state contract's layout entries predate the absorption-era records
body: contracts/ticfac-run-state.json layout.entries lists checkpoint, attempts, evidence, decisions, .index.json and logs/, but the committed records ticks npq/nfo/jlv/wz0 added — absorptions/<key>.json, findings/<key>.json, predictions/<key>.json, absorption-bound.json — are not listed. All are committed run-state records under .ticfac/runs/<run-id>/ and any second implementation of the layout contract (the hosted side) would not know they exist. A later bundle version should enumerate them so the two implementations agree; nothing here depends on it today.
